corrections.reason: The Ethiopic numeral '፰' (8) in '፲፰' (18, citing Isaiah 3:18) was misread as '፳' (20), which would be an invalid compound numeral ('፲፳').
The root of 'ብፅዓን' takes pharyngeal 'ዖ' in 'ናስተብፅዖሙ' (James 5:11), which is clearly printed with the circular pharyngeal glyph 'ዖ' rather than 'ኦ'.
Across the line wrap 'ከጨ↵ፈቀ ፡ ዱር' ('from a dense/thick forest'), the triple-looped 'ጨ' was misread as 'ጰ'.
A non-Ethiopic character ('ส') was erroneously output in Stage 1 instead of the clearly printed Fidel 'ሳ' in the proverbial phrase 'ቢያዩን ፡ እንሳቅ ፡ ባያዩን ፡ እናጠልቅ'.
Joined with 'እያ↵' at the end of Line 32, the complete word is 'እያያዘ' ('one after another / together'), and the image clearly shows 4th-order 'ያ' at the start of Line 33.
